config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licence/register entry, stating the licence-holder register label, optional mixed ABN or ACN, licence issue date, principal business address components, and licence conditions

fields.evidence: ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset Help File, p.8, exact field header AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN: the licensee's ABN or ACN; logic says show ABN when provided, otherwise ACN. Discovery sample row 2 (CSV row 2): 85007186003. The abn operation performs exact 11-digit checksum validation and emits no value for a valid ACN.

ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset Help File, p.8, exact field header AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN: the licensee's ABN or ACN and logic says ACN may be shown if no ABN is provided. This is one mixed source column; the acn operation independently applies exact 9-digit checksum validation, emits no value for a valid ABN, and never derives an ACN from an ABN suffix.
ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset Help File, p.9, exact field header AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL: locality of the current principal business address. Discovery sample row 2: SOUTHBANK.

ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset Help File, p.10, exact field header AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE: state from the current principal business address. Discovery samples rows 2-10 include VIC, NSW and WA. Only ontology-supported Australian state codes are emitted.

ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset Help File, p.10, exact field header AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE: postcode from the current principal business address. The p.12 change log states that addresses outside Australia display null rather than zero. Discovery sample row 2: 3006. Values remain strings; no zero-padding is applied.

ASIC Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset Help File, p.10, exact field header AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY: country from the principal business address; it explicitly states that countries outside Australia are set to the literal sentinel International and blank fields represent unvalidated addresses. Discovery sample row 2: Australia. The sentinel is excluded rather than asserted as an actual country.

unmapped_fields.reason: ASIC Help File p.8 exact header REGISTER_NAME describes only the register classification. The ontology has no register field; it is not evidence of legal entity type or status.
ASIC Help File p.8 exact header AFS_LIC_NUM describes a unique number allocated to the AFS licensee. The ontology subset has no licence-number field, and it must not be used as an ABN or ACN.

ASIC Help File p.8 exact header AFS_LIC_NAME calls this the register entry name and documents person and organisation display formats, but does not establish legal-name, trading-name, or ownership semantics. It is retained as the raw subject label via subject_label_field.
ASIC Help File p.8 exact header AFS_LIC_START_DT defines the date the AFS licence was issued/started. It is not company registration, so it is not mapped to entity.date_registered.

ASIC Help File p.9 exact header AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR describes superseded pre-FSR register identifiers and licence numbers, including nested tilde-delimited values. No compatible licence or predecessor-licence ontology target exists.

ASIC Help File p.11 exact header AFS_LIC_CONDITION describes financial services and products authorised under the licence, with nested tilde-delimited output formats. No compatible licence-condition ontology target exists.

limitations: The source is a point-in-time snapshot of current Australian Financial Services licensees (ASIC Help File p.3), but a licence-holder record does not establish incorporation, legal entity status, deregistration, or company registration date; no entity.status or entity.date_registered mapping is made.
AFS_LIC_NAME is retained only as a raw subject label. The documentation does not distinguish legal names from trading names or prove that every named licensee is a company.

AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is a mixed ABN/ACN field with no per-row type flag. Both checksum validators are applied independently; valid identifiers of the other type produce no value, and no ACN is inferred from an ABN suffix. Unsupported or invalid values are omitted.
The principal business address is component-level and may be unvalidated; no street-level full address, branch, service-location, or ownership claim is inferred.

AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY uses International as a documented sentinel for countries outside Australia. It is explicitly excluded from canonical address.country, as it is not an actual country value; blank/unvalidated values are also omitted.
AFS_LIC_START_DT, AFS_LIC_NUM, AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR, and AFS_LIC_CONDITION remain raw evidence because they describe licence semantics not represented in this ontology subset.

No row-level statement timestamp is supplied. The source envelope must use publication_proxy 2026-09-16T21:52:45.982310 as observed_at, not as a row-change timestamp. Dataset licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia.
